image_description: A stocky, brown, furry marsupial (wombat) is captured in a high-angle shot, foraging on a patch of dirt and grass. The animal has a robust, barrel-shaped body, short limbs, and coarse fur. Its head is lowered towards the ground, obscuring some facial features, but the broad shape and rounded ears are visible. The lighting creates strong shadows, highlighting the texture of the fur and the ground.
